newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse first tier, turnover up.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse first tier, turnover up.

text.p: 1200 GMT - The four high-caps on the Bucharest bourse's first tier dominated trading on Wednesday in a rally extended from last week.
* Three of the four heavyweights saw their prices rise under strong demand ahead of Labour Day on Thursday, when the stock exchange is closed.
* Turnover rose to 8.37 billion lei from the previous 5.15 billion, with almost 95 percent of it accounted for by the first tier.
* Second-tier activity was sluggish, with eight stocks suspended pending company announcements and three companies having no trade.
